title: EnshrineFinance
tagline: Novel collateralization models with enshrined data oracles for RealWorldAssets

description: Most crypto based financing is over-collateralized. While it has all advantages for faster settlements , 24*7 etc, it is still limiting because it  has not yet penetrated to the biggest part of finance, which is working capital management.  Chainaims Enshrine finance brings off-chain web2 oracles of company compliance at different levels in GLEIF, and other compliance for a trust and hence reduce collateralization to promote inclusivity. This opens up a whole bunch of innovation serving MSMEs and EXIM workflows in supply chain finance.
how_its_made: The platform uses APIs from GLEIF ( A Legal Entity Identifier) and is implemented as an MCP server, and exposed to the AS! engine. This service is used as an enshrined oracle in Flare networks to drive Solidity Smart contracts in Flare that have risk-weighted collateral reductions for attestations via the Flare FDC service. the front end is built in react/express and node.
